verses.1: And to Moses, he said, “Go before Jehovah. You, Aaron, his brother, and his father-in-law, along with seventy of the elders of Israel, shall come and worship from a distance.”
verses.2: And Moses went alone to God. They did not go with him, and the people also did not come along with him.
verses.3: And Moses came and told the people all the words of Jehovah, and all the judgments. Then all the people cried out in unison, saying, “All that Jehovah has spoken will be done.”
verses.4: And Moses wrote down all the words of the LORD. He recorded them in the morning. Then he built an altar under the mountain. There were twelve columns for the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.5: And he sent out the young men of Israel. They went up onto the mountain and offered sacrifices to Yahweh, with many offerings.
verses.6: And Moses took half of the blood and put it in containers. He also sprinkled half of the blood on the altar.
verses.7: And he took the book of the covenant, and read it aloud to the people. And they said, “All that the LORD has spoken will be done.”
verses.8: And Moses took the blood and smeared it on the people. He said, “Behold, this is the blood of covenant, which Jehovah has poured out for you regarding all these things.”
verses.9: And Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel stood up.
verses.10: And they saw the God of Israel. Under His feet were the mountains, like branches of a tree, and the heavens themselves became pure.
verses.11: And those sons of Israel who were saved did not stretch out their hands. They did not seek out the gods, and they ate and drank.
verses.12: And the LORD said to Moses, “Go up on the mountain, and I will give you the tablets of stone with writing on them, and the Torah and the commandments that I have written for their instruction.”
verses.13: And Moses stood up, and Joshua took his place as his assistant. Then Moses ascended Mount Sinai.
verses.14: And to the elders, he said, “Stay with us until I return to you. Meanwhile, Aaron and Hur will be with you. They will take care of everything.”
verses.15: And Moses ascended the mountain, and the clouds covered the mountain.
verses.16: And the glory of Jehovah was set up on Mount Sinai. The cloud covered it for six days. On the seventh day, He called out to Moses from within the cloud.
verses.17: And it shall be seen that the glory of Jehovah is like fire that consumes the head of the mountain, in front of the eyes of the children of Israel.
verses.18: And Moses came into the cloud, and he ascended the mountain. Moses stayed on the mountain for forty days and forty nights.
